steps.text: 9:27 A.M. \ Overcast
Atop the wall, Sudean Borough, Londinium

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: There's been a riot at Port 309!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Tell the general the patrol squad has sniffed out the rebels.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: It's not just the rebels! We're exchanging fire with multiple groups––

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: General, can you get us backup?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: How are we doing?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Debugging will take roughly another fifteen minutes.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You've got eight.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: We don't have time to spare here.
You don't need me to go see what's going on down there? Just a suggestion, of course.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You're worried I'll fail.
Of course not. When have your plans ever failed?
My job is just to make sure we've got fewer unknowns along our path to victory.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You've already done more than enough, mercenary.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Come, stand with me. I need you to see for yourself what is going on beneath these walls, before the experiment begins.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Lively.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: How does it compare to the battlefields of Kazdel?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Nothing new.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But at least... it's not Sarkaz on both sides tearing each other apart.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Surely you hunted, during your time in Kazdel.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're asking if I've been hunting? Us mercs are out in the wilderness all year 'round. Hunting is how we get fed.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Then, you should understand why I left these ports open.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Sometimes, even if your trap is obvious, a beast will step right into it because there's no other choice.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: If it can't find a way out, it'll panic and run wild. That means we've got to expend energy and spread our forces thin to round up all the wild beasts.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Sure. That's how things go in the wilds, but there's more to it.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Look at the city below us. It is little more than a concrete wilderness.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Who has the confidence to seal off every exit to the wilds themselves? Who can find every nook and cranny in a jungle? Who can secure every last potential hiding spot?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I am certainly not so conceited.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: So that's why you left a few openings. Focus your attention, and wait for the enemies to reveal themselves. That's a pretty efficient way of dealing with it.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: But it does come with one risk.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Nothing ventured, nothing gained, right?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: If I was in your position, I'd do the same thing.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Good. If you're capable of leading mercenaries, you're capable of leading the hunt.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: That's why I'd rather fight alongside you than the relics in the Court.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: And by the looks of things, you'll be feasting tonight.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Not just the rebels, but Dublinn as well...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Wait, I've seen that caster before. She came to see you once. Didn't you sign a truce? Not that either of you took it particularly seriously.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: If you recognize her, then you should also know that people like her don't know when to stop.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You've been wanting to eliminate that variable for a while now, huh?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The situation has changed. His Majesty's opus is reaching its conclusion. If the theatre is too rowdy, it is too easy to overlook an actual threat.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: We need to keep a closer eye on the dukes out there.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Couldn't you just send me to do that?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: If I wanted her dead, I wouldn't even need you.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: What's the problem then?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: 'The Iron Guard of Wellington.'

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You mean...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: He hasn't made a move on Londinium yet.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: And if he's quiet for even a single day, all the nobles outside Londinium ask their emissaries, first thing in the morning, whether the Iron Duke has spoken.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Which is why we haven't made an enemy of Dublinn, so far.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Now though, since she's the one who lost control and took the first step toward violating our agreement––

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The Sarkaz have no more reason to continue tolerating them.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: So the commotion down there is just the beginning.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Yes. We still need something... more decisive, to take Dublinn out of the picture.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Where the hell did they come from?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: I don't know, Captain... I haven't seen these weapons or Arts before!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: They're also fighting the Sarkaz... They're not here to back up the devils?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Not that it matters. We'll eliminate anyone who gets in our way.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hey––

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Give us our guy back!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: It's... It's you!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Oh, a familiar face? Too bad I still recognize you after the pummeling I gave you this morning.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Look out behind you––

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: People don't just stand around in a fight and wait for you to run up to them swinging.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Isn't that why I have you?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Don't go too crazy. Remember, we're getting out of here as soon as we secure our target.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: That just means I gotta punch faster.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You're telling me... these are the ones who snatched our mark?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Don't forget their faces.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: No, wait a moment... Try to capture one of them alive. I'm sure the Leader would be interested to find out what new power has its eyes on Londinium.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Uhh... Where are these rocks coming from?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Stay on your guard. We're still not inside the city yet, and the Doctor doesn't want to see anyone get hurt.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Alright... You too!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: She smashed my construct to pieces with one swing of a hammer?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: This one... she's just as nasty as that Victorian soldier!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: I wasn't even trying for that one though... See how you like this instead!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Get out of the way, Siege!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Who covered me?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Balin, did you see who that was?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: No, there's too much going on. I can't make heads or tails of it.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Amiya, there's somebody else in this fight.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Someone besides us, Dublinn, and the Sarkaz...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: And they just might be on our side.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Captain, the situation isn't looking good for us... Do you think you could bring down this entire wall...?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: The entire wall, huh? Hah... I've fantasized about it too many times...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: But, not now. We'll still have our chance, whenever the Leader decides to come.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Let's not get too carried away here, and just grit our teeth for the time being...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Hear me. Pack your weapons and try not to leave a mess. I don't want that Manfred devil to come knocking on my door ahead of schedule.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Four minutes. We'll wait four more minutes.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: As it happens, our men haven't had a chance to do anything fun. Defending a city like Londinium is worlds apart from raiding Lateran caravans in the wilderness.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The nice thing about meeting old friends is you don't have to worry about them taking your head. I've got nothing to complain about.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Don't mistake yourself for one of them.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: There aren't a lot of mercenaries out there who could stand being locked up in a little courtyard, reading books all day. That's your department.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I do remember thanking you when you scooped me up and gave me back my sword.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Enough. You're not here to share me this drivel.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Sure, I know.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You need mercenaries, and for more than a couple reasons.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Indeed... And you're as good as they come.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Coincidentally, a few more mercenary squads have joined up with us recently, including some of your old acquaintances from the Scar Market.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: What mercenary could resist an offer from the Regent himself?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: They want more than just the payout from completing a contract or two.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: When we followed the Regent out of Kazdel, each warrior carried a different weapon, some even wearing armor that belonged to the enemy just moments ago.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: But what about now?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: As you've seen, the factories of Londinium now work day and night to produce weapons and armor for us. Our troops are well-regulated, and take orders as a unified unit.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: We are united as never before, and that makes our solidarity stronger than ever.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Yes, all of Victoria... No, all of Terra is watching.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: All according to the Regent's calculations.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Just a year ago, they guffawed about how Londinium's defenses were impenetrable. They thought we were mercenaries in service to some duke.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Profit is no longer the only thing that motivates mercenaries... They are all looking to see what the Sarkaz can do.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: What's a sellsword who's lost interest in selling his sword?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: We're not asking our compatriots to give up their status as mercenaries. They simply found other reasons to follow the Regent.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: They believe he has created a turning point in the fate of the Sarkaz. That we have an opportunity to earn a new identity for ourselves, not just as looters and servants of the powerful.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You need a home to have an identity.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: 'When the Sarkaz desire war, the Sarkaz become war itself––'

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: '––And when each battle ends, the Sarkaz have a home to return to.'

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: This is what the Regent told all the Sarkaz in Londinium. You saw it yourself. That was the first time we met.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I asked what you thought about that statement.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: 'If you're a fighter who crawled out of the ruins of Kazdel, how could you say no to that?'

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: It was three years ago I heard that answer.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Since then, you've left that estate, and now stand with me.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Do you still... hold the same belief?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Manfred, you've earned my loyalty.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Does your left eye still hurt?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: It's been over a year. It healed a long time ago.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I... hope you understand. I've never doubted our friendship, not once since that day.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: But you know what I'm talking about.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The Confessarii don't drop their guard around a merc. That's how they look after the Regent.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: And I... I'm not here to prove my loyalty to anyone. That'd just make me a weaker blade in a fight.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: So your answer is still 'no.'

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: That's fine too.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Sometimes, what I need more is a friend, and for that, Kazdel must temporarily endure the absence of an officer.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We're ready, General!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Excellent.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Tell the patrol to retreat immediately.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Activate the automatic aiming system and enter the long-distance targeting coordinates––

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: ––Coordinates, Sudean Borough, Port 309.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Our efforts over the last few months are finally about to bear fruit.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Hoederer, will you do the honors?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Lieutenant, Dublinn looks like they're about to win.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That's not the situation, but it's also not what matters.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Regardless of who wins, what's important is that they keep each other in check.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That's the situation we need, one that allows your people to charge.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Charge...?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Indeed. While they're too occupied with us, that's your best opportunity to get out of the city.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: No... No!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What's on your mind, Robben?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Lieutenant, I don't want to leave anymore.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: I have to stay.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: But this might be the only chance you have to leave Londinium!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: After the scuffle here today, the Sarkaz will have the gate blocked tomorrow.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Conceal your weapons and blend in with the other civilians! Hurry, get going!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: We can't just run away like this.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Lieutenant, we can still fight.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Did you see that? I just took down a Dublinn fighter and injured two Sarkaz!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: This crossbow is... pretty crude. It's nothing like the standard-issue military crossbows we're used to.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: You made it, right? If you even need to make your weapons yourself, don't you also need more men?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It's not a question of what I need...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: If you don't want to leave, I won't force you.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I don't want to order another good soldier out of the fight, not again, not when she wanted to stay...

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Lieutenant...?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: But let's set that aside for now.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We need to get out of here first.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Now's the best shot we're going to get, so if you don't want to move onwards, then fall back with us!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, the Sarkaz troops are withdrawing from the fight.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I find it strange that after fighting us and Dublinn for so long, the Sarkaz didn't call in reinforcements or start massacring the Dublinn forces.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's not how the Sarkaz usually fight. Even the mercenaries that W brought with her into Reunion fought more ferociously than they did.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, have we fallen into a trap?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This conflict came about so spontaneously and coincidentally... It's as if someone was trying to corral us all together, and then...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Umm, do you think they set all this up for us?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Siege said she found other people who were blending into the crowd just like us... and they seemed to be on the civilians' side.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Might they be the ones the Sarkaz were after?

options: Combat operators, withdraw from the battlefield immediately.
Scout teams, cover the escape for our combat operators and the civilians.
Everyone, find the nearest place to bunker down and prepare to evacuate!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Doctor ordered a retreat.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Huh? We're about to complete our rescue though!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: There must be a reason behind it. Let's go.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Grr.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Excuse me, Miss Indra! I, I'm over here!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Thomas?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Don't go over there!
A flash of light suddenly fills everyone's eyes.
A scalding wave of heat erupts forth, incinerating almost everything it touches.
Though very little solid debris shoots out, the force of the impact reminds the survivors how they were only a single step from death.
And this threat... came from above.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What just happened?!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Did we get a bomb dropped on us? A huge crater... suddenly appeared in the ground?!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Thomas... *cough* *cough*... The smoke's too thick, I can't see anything!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Indra!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Siege told you to stop.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Fine, I owe you another one.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: As long as you get it. Now hurry, let's get out of here––
